# GameFAQs — A Great Strategy game!

- Original source: [A Great Strategy game!](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/562021-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/reviews/64735)
- Author / publication: rios_always; GameFAQs.
- Language / date: English; 2003-11-30.
- Access: Review text inspected; PC URL used to avoid platform-mirror ambiguity.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The player awards 8/10 overall, praising simple controls, varied character attacks, mission objectives, and detailed graphics. They find the presentation somewhat cartoonish and wish for more cinematic storytelling. Having only the campaign limits the available modes, although the reviewer expects to enjoy repeating it.

This is a brief contemporary player review rather than a systematic technical assessment. The same review appears beneath GameFAQs’ Linux navigation, despite its 2003 date; that mirrored page is not evidence that the writer tested the Linux port.
